criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested operating-review sheet.
The source-selection record identifies the only approved, complete 2024Q2 schema-1.1 release.
Consolidated_Data contains exactly the six records from the selected release and no mixed-release records.
All four operating KPIs equal the independent replay of the selected records.
The selection explanation addresses approval, reporting period, schema, and regional coverage.
The chosen release identifier and file remain visible with the selected records.
Regional record counts and recognized revenue close to the six selected records.
Every release-registry source field is preserved exactly from release_registry.csv.
The chosen-source reason, four required-region statuses, and evidence labels remain reviewable.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查是否选中已批准且覆盖完整的 Q2 版本，并让选择说明、明细、KPI 和地区覆盖检查指向同一份数据。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 按版本内容、表头、期间、地区和批准状态查找交付，不因工作表名或公式形式不同而扣分。
accepted_equivalents_zh: 说明文字的合理近义表达
公式或静态的正确 KPI
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 工作簿同时展示多个版本且没有明确最终选择，无法将说明与 KPI 归到同一来源时，应先记录定位问题。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 还要加入更多合理布局，并防止评分程序从几张相互矛盾的表中拼出高分。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
